items.title: Pin the paraphrase behaviour with fixtures, then either broaden the relation test or document the list as deliberately closed
items.context: RED: fixtures for settles and resolves in the generic-pair cell and in the two dedicated detectors, asserting whichever behaviour the story chooses, failing today because the behaviour is unpinned either way. GREEN: implement that choice. If broadening, keep the false positive that B-1482 fixed clear (Note on priority: the story is high-risk on its merits) and keep the four B-1482 probe sentences caught.
